meta.name: McQueen Cloud Advisory
meta.authority: Canonical brand data v2.0 drives the playbook, workbook, tokens and asset manifest. Current website palette is retained. New logo masters replace generated legacy variants.
meta.authoring: Google Workspace first; editable Office files remain compatible imports. No Adobe subscription required.

strategy.positioning: McQueen Cloud Advisory helps small and midsize organizations simplify back-office work and turn scattered data into reporting they can trust.
strategy.supporting: Practical analytics, automation, and systems design informed by enterprise experience and sized for smaller teams.
strategy.human_benefit: Less time copying data, chasing updates, and assembling reports. More time serving customers, supporting people, and making decisions.
strategy.headline: Complex operations. Clear systems.
strategy.audience: Small and midsize organizations with recurring operational work, inconsistent reporting, or disconnected tools. Churches and nonprofits are relevant examples, not the umbrella brand.
buyers: Administrators with budget authority or an executive sponsor
qualifiers: A recurring problem with observable consequences
An accountable process owner and a decision-maker
Access to the relevant data and systems
Staff time to validate, adopt and maintain the result
brand_traits: Explain what changes in daily work and how it will be maintained.
Use evidence and sound tradeoffs to demonstrate enterprise experience.
Translate platform terms into decisions, inputs, ownership and outcomes.
Explain the staff capacity and service benefit without promising headcount savings.
principles: Start with the operating problem and the people doing the work.
Use existing tools where they meet the requirement.
Apply appropriate controls without imposing enterprise-scale complexity.
Leave a system and instructions the client can own.

offers.name: Analytics and Reporting
offers.promise: Turn scattered data into clear reporting your team can use with confidence.
offers.scope: Agree on measures, organize sources, build a focused report or dashboard, reconcile results, and document refresh and ownership.
offers.deliverables: Metric definitions; source-to-report map; focused report or dashboard; validation evidence; refresh and ownership instructions.
offers.proof: Source reconciliation, stable definitions, preparation time and actual use.
offers.boundary: Advanced forecasting, custom machine learning and unrestricted platform migrations require separate scope.

offers.name: Workflow Automation
offers.promise: Reduce repetitive administration and make everyday handoffs easier.
offers.scope: Map one recurring process, simplify steps, automate appropriate handoffs, define exceptions, and train the process owner.
offers.deliverables: Current and future workflow; agreed automation; exception handling; owner instructions; handoff.
offers.proof: Time spent, missed steps, rework and turnaround before and after.
offers.boundary: No unbounded support, emergency monitoring or promise that every task can be automated.

offers.name: Workspace and Systems Design
offers.promise: Organize the tools and information your team relies on.
offers.scope: Improve shared files, forms, permissions and information flow; design proportionate integrations where needed.
offers.deliverables: Information structure; access and ownership plan; configuration or prototype; implementation roadmap; operating instructions.
offers.proof: Findability, consistent access, clear ownership and simpler recurring work.
offers.boundary: Not a general helpdesk, AV/production service or full outsourced IT department.

strategy.engagement_path: Understand the problem; agree a bounded scope and acceptance criteria; implement and validate; hand over; support only under an agreed arrangement.
strategy.platform_rule: Google Workspace and Google Cloud are core capabilities and the internal production preference. Use Microsoft 365 when it fits the client. A new platform is recommended only when requirements justify it.
proof_rules: Label employment projects as professional experience, not consulting clients.
Label pro bono client work as pro bono. Separate completed work, proposals and demonstrations.
Quantified results need a supportable baseline, period, scope, attribution and permission to publish.
Do not imply employer endorsement, a larger team, unverified partner status or certifications.
Describe accuracy, security and compliance controls specifically; avoid guarantees.
An efficiency estimate represents recovered capacity unless an actual expense reduction is demonstrated.

theme_rules: Web content, proposals, SOWs, invoices, executive reports, printed documents and most slide interiors.
Presentation covers and dividers, selected social covers, short video opening/closing frames, digital campaigns and optional dark web sections.
One dark treatment per composition; preserve whitespace. Keep report and legal document interiors light. Use a designated reversed symbol, not automatic inversion.
4.5:1 for normal text; 3:1 for large text (18 pt regular or 14 pt bold) and essential non-text controls. Check actual adjacent colors. Color alone never communicates status.
Use very sparingly, behind or beside content. They do not replace the primary logo and must contain no baked legacy wordmark.

typography.rule: 16px minimum on mobile; text measure 60-75 characters
Use muted on light, dark_muted on dark
Short identifiers and figure labels only; 14px for code blocks
Outlined Geist lettering in final SVG; regenerate from the approved font and spelling. Never guess the legacy raster font.
Inline baseline; descriptor is 64/92 of name size
Secondary notes only; no essential instructions below 11pt
One clear title above a table
Wrap long entries; row at least 28px and expand as needed
Short notes only; never hide required instructions
18pt floor; shorten content instead of shrinking
48px floor; max 12 words and three lines
Name 14px bold; links blue; retain live text

font_rules: Geist Sans and Geist Mono are the web and designed-asset families.
Arial is the approved Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, email and Office fallback. It is a deliberate cross-platform choice, not a new brand family.
Do not assume a font is available in Google Docs because it appears in Google Fonts. Use Arial when Geist is unavailable.
For logos keep the supplied final image intact in Google tools; use editable text beside the symbol only in a template that specifies it.
Use actual installed weights; do not synthesize decorative outlines, stretched letters or faux small caps.
Fonts bundled with this kit retain their SIL Open Font License notices.

logo_rules.concept: A restrained evolution of the existing cloud, bar forms and supporting base. The new flat symbol and Geist wordmark replace the textured generated masters.
logo_rules.clear_space: At least H/4 on all sides, where H is the visible symbol height. Measure from visible artwork, not file canvas. In very small favicon tiles use the dedicated micro asset instead.
logo_rules.micro_rule: Use the dedicated simple M micro mark at 16-32px. Use the full symbol at 48px or above. A micro mark is an application asset, not an alternative corporate logo.
logo_rules.light_rule: Blue cloud with ink/slate bar forms on white or the light canvas.
logo_rules.dark_rule: A separately approved reversed master on ink or dark_surface; canvas-white bar forms and ice/white cloud. Never invert automatically.
logo_rules.wordmark_rule: McQueen and Cloud Advisory use the exact approved spelling and capitalization. Horizontal is primary; stacked is for square or narrow spaces. No tagline inside a small lockup.
dont: Do not stretch, skew, crop or rotate logo artwork.
Do not add shadows, gradients, glows, outlines or a new enclosing box.
Do not put the light symbol on a dark background if its ink shapes disappear.
Do not use a supplied legacy banner as a header logo.
Do not recreate the wordmark by guessing the old generated font.
Do not imply Google endorsement or add partner badges without current authorization.
logo_rules.master_format: Native SVG paths for both symbol and outlined wordmark. Transparent PNGs support Google Docs and Slides. These are newly authored geometric masters, not automatic traces of the old textured PNG.

layout.rule: Use one primary CTA, aligned edges, consistent spacing and quiet backgrounds. Logo clear space and destination safe zones override generic inset values.

docs: Set Letter portrait, 0.75in margins and Arial defaults.
Use native Title and Heading styles. Titles and headings stay black; blue is for links and limited accents.
Use the transparent horizontal light lockup at 3.2-3.6in wide, preserving the 80mm minimum. Use a symbol plus live business name if a narrower header is necessary.
Tables use 0.5pt #D8DFE7 grid lines as decorative separators, light canvas header fill and ink text. Essential meaning must not depend on those borders.
Export a PDF and inspect every page before sending; keep the editable original.
sheets: Use Arial10pt body, 10pt bold table headers and an 18pt title.
Use one row per record, typed dates/numbers and descriptive headers. Ratios such as 9:16 remain text.
Freeze the header row(s), enable filters for reference tables and expand row height for wrapped text.
Use white cells and restrained soft row striping; reserve blue for emphasis, links and clearly labeled inputs.
Use the spreadsheet as the operational specification register; update the canonical data and playbook in the same version.
slides: Build a light cover and a dark cover; use light content slides for charts and longer reading.
Keep the symbol and live headline separate. Use the supplied lockup image when consistency matters.
Use cover36pt, heading28pt, body20pt and caption14pt. Keep one message per slide.
Use no heavy illustrated background behind analytical charts or dense text.
reports: Begin with the decision, reporting period and key conclusion.
Show data definitions, source/refresh timing, limitations and an accountable owner.
Use blue for the main series, slate for comparison, teal for a third category and ink for a fourth.
Label series directly when possible. Pair status colors with words, icons or patterns.
Use consistent scales and units. Do not decorate charts with 3D, glows or gradients.

approved_copy.copy: McQueen Cloud Advisory helps small and midsize organizations simplify back-office work and turn scattered data into reporting they can trust.
Clear reporting, simpler workflows, and organized tools for small and midsize organizations. Spend less time on administration and more time serving customers, members, and communities.
Analytics, automation, and systems design for smaller teams.
Experience from complex enterprise environments, applied to useful systems your team can run and maintain.
Simplify administrative work and give staff more time for the people and communities they serve.
I help teams connect the business question to reporting and workflows that hold up in everyday use.

qa: Use one approved master, correct variant and current version; verify clearspace and minimum size.
Use the channel-specific family and actual weight. Check fallback behavior, wrapping and mobile size.
Use canonical values. Verify actual text/background and essential-control contrast.
Lead with the operating problem and business consequence. Verify claims, attribution and publication permission.
Check actual destination size, mobile/desktop crop, file size and image density.
Verify labels, units, sources, periods, calculations and status cues.
Review the PDF or image at normal viewing size. Keep editable text and source files.
Name assets consistently and record the version. Archive superseded files outside active templates.
implementation: Use the new masters and channel templates for new materials; keep originals as reference only.
Keep this JSON, playbook, workbook and exported tokens together. Update shared values once, regenerate and review.
Retain current palette and Geist families; proposed service labels and broad SMB copy are recommendations to implement separately. No website has been changed by this deliverable.
Import the editable DOCX/XLSX into Google tools. Check page breaks, font fallback, row heights and charts after conversion.
Scott owns changes to strategy, claims, logo masters and tokens. Review at a material offering change or a new channel launch.
